text: dsh-checkdigit 是面向 DSH agent 的校验位数学工具箱，通过向每个现有及新建 agent 注册工具，支持生成和验证多种标识符校验位、自动识别格式、查找单字符修复、批量校验、从文本扫描标识符、查询方案信息以及 ISBN-10/13 转换。实现采用本地算术，不需要 API key 或外部服务，适合在处理书号、条码、金融标识符和混合文本时核对输入。

dsh-checkdigit gives DSH agents offline tools to generate and validate check digits, detect identifier schemes, suggest single-edit repairs, check batches, scan text, and convert ISBN-10/13. It registers on existing and new agents and uses local arithmetic without API keys or external services.
帮我验证一批 ISBN 和条码的校验位。
有办法从一段邮件里找出 IBAN 或书号吗？
输入的编号校验失败时，能提示可能改错了哪个字符吗？
我想把 ISBN-10 转成 ISBN-13 并重新计算校验位。
I need to check whether a list of identifiers has valid check digits.
Can I find valid ISBNs and account identifiers inside pasted text?
想检查一列数据中哪些编码的校验位不正确。
I want to spot likely single-character typos in a code that failed validation.
dsh-checkdigit 的功能「生成并验证标识符校验位」：为用户提供对应的校验位处理。通过 DSH agent 中的工具调用触发，输入编号、批次或文本并返回校验结果、识别项或转换结果。
dsh-checkdigit 的功能「批量校验编号」：为用户提供对应的校验位处理。通过 DSH agent 中的工具调用触发，输入编号、批次或文本并返回校验结果、识别项或转换结果。
dsh-checkdigit 的功能「从自由文本扫描编号」：为用户提供对应的校验位处理。通过 DSH agent 中的工具调用触发，输入编号、批次或文本并返回校验结果、识别项或转换结果。
dsh-checkdigit 的功能「查找单字符修复建议」：为用户提供对应的校验位处理。通过 DSH agent 中的工具调用触发，输入编号、批次或文本并返回校验结果、识别项或转换结果。
dsh-checkdigit 的功能「双向转换 ISBN-10 与 ISBN-13」：为用户提供对应的校验位处理。通过 DSH agent 中的工具调用触发，输入编号、批次或文本并返回校验结果、识别项或转换结果。

dsh-checkdigit README · dsh-checkdigit：Check-digit mathematics toolbox for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh): generate, validate, repair and detect check digits for **19 schemes** — Luhn, Verhoeff, Damm, ISBN-10, ISBN-13, EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A, GTIN-14, ISSN, ISIN, CUSIP, **SEDOL**, IBAN, **CAS Registry Number**, **ABA routing number**, **NPI**, **LEI** and **ORCID iD** — plus an **ISBN-10 ⇄ ISBN-13 converter**, a **single-edit repair search** ("what was this number most likely meant to be?"), a **batch validator** for whole columns of identifiers and a **free-text scanner** that finds identifiers inside prose.

dsh-checkdigit README · dsh-checkdigit：> 校验位数学工具箱：生成 / 验证 / 修复 / 识别 19 种校验位（Luhn、Verhoeff、Damm、ISBN、EAN、UPC、GTIN-14、ISSN、ISIN、CUSIP、SEDOL、IBAN、CAS 化学文摘号、ABA 美国银行路由号、NPI 美国医疗提供者号、LEI 法人识别码、ORCID 学者号），另带 ISBN-10 与 ISBN-13 互转、「单字符修复」搜索工具、批量校验工具与**自由文本扫描**工具；零运行时依赖、纯本地算术。

dsh-checkdigit README · Why：Language models routinely botch check-digit arithmetic: wrong card-number checksums, ISBNs that fail validation, IBANs with impossible check digits. Every algorithm here is implemented from its published specification with **pure integer arithmetic** — deterministic, offline, zero runtime dependencies — and cross-checked against published worked examples (Apple's `US0378331005`, the classic `GB82 WEST 1234 5698 7654 32`, the Luhn textbook example `79927398713`, water's CAS number `7732-18-5`, and more).

dsh-checkdigit README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:TYEclipse/dsh-checkdigit
```

Then add `dsh-checkdigit` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in your profile's `package.json` if it is not auto-activated, and restart dsh.

dsh-checkdigit README · `checkdigit_generate`：Compute the check digit for a payload and return the complete identifier.

```text
checkdigit_generate(scheme="luhn", payload="7992739871")
→ checkDigit: "3", complete: "79927398713"
```

Supported `scheme` values and their payloads:

dsh-checkdigit README · `checkdigit_generate`：| scheme    | payload                             | check digit      | example complete |
|-----------|-------------------------------------|------------------|------------------|
| `luhn`    | digits (any length ≥ 1)             | last digit       | `79927398713` |
| `verhoeff`| digits (any length ≥ 1)             | last digit       | `2363` |
| `damm`    | digits (any length ≥ 1)             | last digit       | `5724` |
| `isbn10`  | 9 digits                            | 10th char (0-9 or X) | `0306406152` |
| `isbn13`  | 12 digits                           | 13th digit       | `9780306406157` |
| `ean8`    | 7 digits                            | 8th digit        | `96385074` |
| `ean13`   | 12 digits                           | 13th digit       | `4006381333931` |
| `upca`    | 11 digits                           | 12th digit       | `036000291452` |
| `gtin14`  | 13 digits                           | 14th digit       | `09780306406157` |
| `issn`    | 7 digits                            | 8th char (0-9 or X) | `03785955` |
| `isin`    | 2 letters + 9 alphanumerics         | 12th char (digit)| `US0378331005` |
| `cusip`   | 8 chars
dsh-checkdigit README · `checkdigit_generate`：Use it to build test card numbers, ISBNs, barcodes, securities identifiers, routing numbers or account numbers whose check digits actually verify.

dsh-checkdigit README · `checkdigit_validate`：Verify the check digit of a full identifier. The scheme is auto-detected when omitted (CAS hyphenated → ISIN → 9-digit ABA → CUSIP → SEDOL (letter-leading) → IBAN → LEI (only when the mod-97 remainder confirms it) → ORCID inside the `0000-000x` block → EAN-13 → UPC-A → ISSN (X-terminated) → EAN-8 → ISBN-10 → Luhn); pass `scheme` to force one. SEDOLs that are all digits and every NPI share their length with Luhn/ISBN-10 values, so those two have to be named — and so does a sixteen-digit value outside the ORCID block, which stays a card number.

dsh-checkdigit README · `checkdigit_validate`：```text
checkdigit_validate(value="GB82WEST12345698765432")
→ valid: true, scheme: "iban", iban.country: "GB", iban.formatted: "GB82 WEST 1234 5698 7654 32"

checkdigit_validate(value="7732-18-5")

Spaces, dashes and dots in the input are ignored (the spaced card form `4111 1111 1111 1111`, the hyphenated `978-0-306-40615-7` and the printed `0378-5955` all validate). When a value is invalid, the result carries the **expected** check digit so callers can fix it programmatically.

dsh-checkdigit README · `checkdigit_repair`：When a value fails, enumerate the **single-character edits that make it valid** — a corrected check character, a swapped adjacent pair, or one mistyped payload character. Every repair is confirmed by the scheme's own validator and ordered most-likely-first.

```text
checkdigit_repair(value="79927398714")
→ scheme: "luhn", total: 12, checkDigit: "4", expected: "3"
  repairs[0]: { type: "check-digit", position: 11, from: "4", to: "3", value: "79927398713" }

dsh-checkdigit README · `checkdigit_repair`：Both IBAN answers are legitimate — the caller can see whether the account digits or the check digits were more likely mistyped. `total` always reports the full count; the returned list is capped at 20 (`truncated: true`).

dsh-checkdigit README · `checkdigit_batch`：Validate a whole column of identifiers in one call — 1 to 50 values, request order preserved. Each value is auto-detected unless a `scheme` is given for the whole list, and the report carries one row per value plus the counts and a per-scheme breakdown.

dsh-checkdigit README · `checkdigit_batch`：```text
checkdigit_batch(values=["79927398713","79927398714","B15KXQ8","B15KXQ7","978-0-306-40615-7",
                         "GB82WEST12345698765432","not-an-id","1234567893"])
→ total: 8, validCount: 4, invalidCount: 3, unknownCount: 1
  byScheme: [luhn×2, sedol×2, ean13×1, iban×1, isbn10×1, unknown×1]

dsh-checkdigit README · `checkdigit_batch`：Use it for pasted lists and spreadsheet columns instead of one validation call per row. An empty list or more than 50 values is rejected with an `error` and no rows — the list is never truncated silently.

dsh-checkdigit README · `checkdigit_scan`：Find identifiers inside free text — a receipt, an email, a pasted page — instead of a one-per-line column. Every whitespace-separated string is tried against the known formats, and adjacent groups are merged **only when the merged value passes its own check digit**, which is how `GB82 WEST 1234 5698 7654 32` and `978 0 306 40615 7` are recognised while ordinary prose is not. Each hit comes back with the character offsets needed to slice it out of the text.

dsh-checkdigit README · `checkdigit_scan`：```text
checkdigit_scan(text="Invoice 2026-11: card 4111 1111 1111 1111 charged, ISBN 978 0 306 40615 7, "
                     "LEI 529900T8BM49AURSDO55, ORCID 0000-0002-1825-0097, "
                     "IBAN GB82 WEST 1234 5698 7654 32, SEDOL B15KXQ8.")
→ scanned: 22, total: 6, validCount: 6

dsh-checkdigit README · `checkdigit_scan`：Two rules keep the output honest: a merge may only start from a token that carries a digit (so a word is never glued onto the front of a number), and the longest grouping is tried first so the complete identifier wins over a prefix that happens to pass by chance. Auto-detection reports Luhn only for 12–19 digit runs, so years and house numbers are not "card numbers"; name `schemes` to look for one scheme regardless of shape. `includeInvalid: true` also reports single strings whose format matched but whose check digit failed — a typo hint, with the character it should have been.

dsh-checkdigit README · `checkdigit_info`：Describe the supported schemes: identifier lengths, payload formats, check-digit positions and worked examples. Call with a `scheme` for one scheme, or without arguments for all 19.

dsh-checkdigit README · `isbn_convert`：Convert between ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 in both directions. The source check digit is verified first; the 978 Bookland prefix is prepended (10→13) or dropped (13→10) and the target check digit recomputed. Hyphen grouping from the input is preserved in `formatted`.

```text
isbn_convert(isbn="0-306-40615-2")
→ valid: true, direction: "to13", converted: "9780306406157", formatted: "978-0-306-40615-7"

isbn_convert(isbn="978-0-306-40615-7")
dsh-checkdigit README · `isbn_convert`：ISBN-10 check digits may be `X` (value 10): `0-8044-2957-X` → `978-0-8044-2957-3`.

dsh-checkdigit README · Supported schemes：| Scheme | Standard | Detail |
|--------|----------|--------|
| Luhn | ISO/IEC 7812 | Credit/debit cards, IMEI, loyalty cards |
| Verhoeff | — | Dihedral-group checksum; catches all single errors and adjacent transpositions |
| Damm | — | Quasigroup operation; full-value tally must be zero |
| ISBN-10 | ISO 2108 | Mod-11; check digit may be `X` (= 10) |
| ISBN-13 | ISO 2108 | EAN-13 arithmetic (Bookland) |
| EAN-8 / EAN-13 | GS1 GTIN-8 / GTIN-13 | Retail barcodes |
| GTIN-14 / SSCC-18 | GS1 GTIN-14 | Logistics case and pallet codes; same mod-10 weighting as EAN/UPC over a 13-digit payload |
| ISSN | ISO 3297 | Serial publications; mod-11 check character may be `X` |
| UPC-A | GS1 GTIN-12 | North American retail barcodes |
| ISIN | ISO 6166 | Securities; letters expand A=10…Z=35, then Luhn |
| CUSIP | ANSI X9.6 | North American securities; `* @ #` allowed; even positions doubled |
| SEDOL | London Stock Exchange | UK/Ireland securities; 7 chars, weights 1,3,1,7,3,9, letters A=10…Z=35, vowels never issued |
| IBAN | ISO 13616 | Mod-97 over letter-expanded rearranged string; BBAN length table for 75+ countries |
| CAS Registry Number | CAS | C

dsh-checkdigit README · Development：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build
pnpm test   # 119 tests
pnpm lint

Test expectations are not hand-computed: `test/oracle/anchors.py` re-implements each scheme from its published specification in Python and prints every anchor the suites assert, including the repair counts and positions. Run it (or `pnpm test` on a fresh checkout) to regenerate them.
